ref.description: One object ref returned by docx_list_objects or docx_find_literal. Select the smallest object that contains the needed detail; for a large table, page its rows first and read only the selected rows.

revision.description: Optional expected revision id from the observation receipt; a changed document fails as stale.

kinds.description: Object kinds required by the next operation. Include paragraph when paragraph boundaries affect a later content selection.

output.description: Absolute path for a new JSON artifact containing the selected native object and only the requested descendant kinds.
